# Chart.js 4.5.1

Vendored UMD build so local charts do not need a CDN connection or send requests
to a third-party host. No npm installation or build step is required.

- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js
- Official project: https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/tree/v4.5.1
- Integration: https://www.chartjs.org/docs/latest/getting-started/integration.html
- License: MIT; see LICENSE.md.
- JavaScript SHA-256: 48444a82d4edcb5bec0f1965faacdde18d9c17db3063d042abada2f705c9f54a

The upstream source map is not bundled. The build is served only at the explicit
`/assets/chartjs-4.5.1.js` route; private files are not mounted as static content.
